Functions.Name: Prf_BitWordNum
Functions.Original: static inline int    Prf_BitWordNum( int nWidth )                { return (nWidth >> 6) + ((nWidth & 63) > 0);                           }

Functions.Name: Prf_ManSize
Functions.Original: static inline int    Prf_ManSize( Prf_Man_t * p )                { return Vec_WrdSize( p->vInfo ) / p->nWords;                           }
Functions.Draft: func Prf_ManSize(p *Prf_Man_t) int32 { return Vec_WrdSize( p.vInfo ) / p.nWords;                           }

Functions.Name: Prf_ManClearNewInfo
Functions.Original: static inline void   Prf_ManClearNewInfo( Prf_Man_t * p )        { int w; for ( w = 0; w < p->nWords; w++ ) Vec_WrdPush( p->vInfo, 0 );  }
Functions.Draft: func Prf_ManClearNewInfo(p *Prf_Man_t) { var w int32; for  w = 0; w < p.nWords; w++  { Vec_WrdPush( p.vInfo, 0 ); }  }

Functions.Name: Prf_ManClauseInfo
Functions.Original: static inline word * Prf_ManClauseInfo( Prf_Man_t * p, int Id )  { return Vec_WrdEntryP( p->vInfo, Id * p->nWords );                     }
